tf_grid: edge-origin with step 0.25: LR pixel i maps exactly onto HR 4i, so the first and last LR samples land on the HR border

cv2_inter_cubic.reference_grid: half-pixel-centred: sample i sits at (i+0.5)/4-0.5 in LR units (origin -0.375, step 0.25)

torch_align_corners_false.reference_grid: half-pixel-centred: sample i sits at (i+0.5)/4-0.5 in LR units (origin -0.375, step 0.25)

torch_align_corners_true.reference_grid: corner grid: grid spans corner to corner (align_corners=True style)

sign_convention.displacement: positive = bicubic_four's IMAGE sits right/down of the reference (the same content appears at a larger HR index)
sign_convention.corrective_input_shift: warping the LR input with +s moves the output content right by s, so the input shift that cancels a displacement d is exactly d

corrective_lr_shift_vs_cv2.note: warp the LR input by this much (cv2.warpAffine, +shift moves content right/down) to register bicubic_four onto the cv2/OpenCV half-pixel convention
